messages:
Ava S.: Hey team – AcmeCorp sent back the SIG and wants evidence for ~12 controls. Can we do question-by-question? They need AC-2, privileged access, encryption, logging, backups. Deadline EOD Thu.
Ben K.: I can take AC-2 and AC-6 (accounts & privileged). Where should I drop evidence?
Caroline L.: Use the SIG evidence confluence page – I already uploaded the account inventory: https://confluence.redwood.com/security/sig/evidence and the CSV export at `s3://redwood-sec/sig/ac-2-inventory-20260201.csv`.
Dmitri (sec): For AC-2: we rotate service account keys every 90 days. Evidence is key rotation policy + CloudTrail logs. I added screenshots and a sample log to Confluence.
Ava S.: @Dmitri can you paste the exact CloudTrail snippet we can hand to them? Acme accepts logs + policy doc.
Dmitri (sec): Sure — sample log: 
```
{ "eventTime": "2026-02-20T14:12:03Z", "eventName": "RotateServiceAccountKey", "userIdentity": {"type":"Service"}, "requestParameters": {...} }
```
Also policy doc: https://confluence.redwood.com/security/policies/key-rotation.md
Ben K.: For privileged access (AC-6) we use Okta SSO + short-lived AWS roles. Evidence: Okta audit export + IAM role list at `s3://redwood-sec/sig/priv-roles-2026-02-18.json`. I uploaded a sample Okta audit CSV.
Caroline L.: Encryption at rest (SIG question mapping for SC-13): envelope encryption using KMS. I added CMK ARNs and the CMK policy to the page.
Ava S.: Logging/monitoring (SI-4): customer wants retention proof and searchable logs. Do we have screenshots and retention policy?
Dmitri (sec): Logs retained 13 months in ELK; index and retention policy screenshots are on the observability page (https://observability.redwood.com/indices/logs-*). PagerDuty escalation and on-call runbooks are here: Confluence -> Oncall -> Runbooks -> Incident Response.
Ava S.: Backup evidence? They want encryption + restore test proof.
Caroline L.: Nightly DB snapshots encrypted, stored in separate backup account. Manifest: `s3://redwood-sec/backups/backup-manifest-20260201.csv`. I also uploaded the restore test runbook and screenshots of successful restore to staging (restore-2026-01-15).
Ava S.: Perfect. Can someone consolidate into a single package and upload to the shared folder for Acme? They asked for a single bundle.
Ben K.: I'll assemble a package: `sig_acme_evidence_20260202.zip` and upload to `https://files.redwood.com/sharing/sig-acme-1764209876` (link expires in 7 days). I'll include a mapping sheet that ties each SIG question to the file name.
sig-automation-bot: Evidence package received and scanned: 12 docs, 1 screenshot. No PII found. (scan-id: scan-9a3f)
Ava S.: One more: Acme asked if we offer a private deployment option suitable for PHI (question PR-7). @Dmitri any blockers?
Dmitri (sec): We have Private offering (VPC + optional HSM). HSM/KMS integration documented; legal needs to sign DPA addendum. DPA template: https://legal.redwood.com/templates/dpa_hsm_v1.pdf. No technical blockers — ops will provision in a separate account.
Caroline L.: I'm adding checkboxes next to each SIG question in Confluence and will link the exact evidence file so the customer can follow question -> artifact.
Ava S.: Deadline reminder: Acme expects delivery EOD Thu. Ben can you upload by 12:00 PT so I can review?
Ben K.: Yes, I'll finish assembling and upload by 11:50 PT. :+1:
Ava S.: Thanks. Once uploaded I'll attach the mapping sheet and ping Acme.
Ben K.: Done — uploaded `sig_acme_evidence_20260202.zip` and mapping sheet. Link: https://files.redwood.com/sharing/sig-acme-1764209876 (expires in 7d). :tada:
Ava S.: Reviewing now. Looks good, I'll send to Acme and include the mapping CSV.
Caroline L.: FYI I also added internal ticket RD-4231 to track follow-ups (legal DPA, extra logs request).
Dmitri (sec): Noted. If Acme requests longer log retention or FedRAMP specifics, we should escalate to product.
Ava S.: Great teamwork — I'll update the deal notes.
